name: Cross-chain airdrop
description: Distribute the same token to recipient lists on multiple chains in parallel from a single composer pass. Each row is an independent airdrop - the composer's no-rollback warning applies.

actions.note: Reference a previously-broadcast recipient list on chain A (use the Airdrop form to create the list first if you don't have one yet).
Reference a separate recipient list on chain B. The two airdrops broadcast independently - failures on one chain do not affect the other.
Optional third chain. Remove this row if you only want to distribute on two chains.
